translations.web: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.
translations.bsb: A large population is a king’s splendor, but a lack of subjects is a prince’s ruin.
translations.kjv: In the multitude of people is the king's honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
translations.asv: In the multitude of people is the king's glory; But in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
